name: Device42
summary: Device42 discovers on-premises, cloud and software assets and records lifecycle events, purchases and contracts for each device. It publishes no prices. Its pricing page says the software is an annual subscription based on the number of devices, and a free trial is offered through a form.

facts.text: Device42 says it discovers software on Windows, Mac and Linux across servers and desktops, covering on-premises and SaaS software.
Lifecycle events record a date, time and event type for each device, and purchases and contracts can be recorded against it.
Licenses are valid for one year from purchase and renewal goes through Device42 support. A device uses 1 license unit, 10 containers use 1 unit and storage is bought separately at 1 unit per 50 TB.

plans.name: Annual subscription
plans.notes: No rates published. Priced on the number of devices

hiddenCosts: Storage is licensed separately from device units, and extra modules are sold separately.
